nodes.name: AppLogo.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Pāvati Pustak logo image inside a fixed-size rounded maroon container, used in the app header and login/signup pages.

nodes.name: FestivalPicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Interactive festival selection component allowing users to toggle predefined festivals from the shared FESTIVALS list and add up to 20 custom festival names, with validation and toast feedback.

nodes.name: LogoutButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a log out button that invokes the shared logout authentication action.

nodes.name: ReceiptPreview.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides a canvas-based receipt preview component that renders a receipt template with live data via the shared receipt engine, handling background image loading and render errors.

nodes.name: TemplateFieldOverlay.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements a draggable/resizable overlay editor for receipt template fields over a background image, supporting field selection, move, and resize via pointer events.

nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the authenticated app layout shell including a permission-filtered sidebar navigation, a trust switcher dropdown, responsive mobile menu, and header, wrapping page content.

nodes.name: ui.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared UI component library providing Button, Card, Badge, Input, Select, Textarea, Modal, Spinner, EmptyState, StatCard, PageHeader, and Pagination with branded styling.

nodes.name: AccountPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Account management page for viewing/editing the user's profile, changing password (excluding Google users), listing trust memberships, and viewing personal donation history with receipt downloads.

nodes.name: AnnouncementsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Lists trust announcements with pagination, permission-based pin/delete actions, colored type badges, and a link to create new announcements.

nodes.name: CreateAnnouncementPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Form page for creating a trust announcement with title, content, media upload, type selection, and pin option.

nodes.name: AuditLogPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the trust audit log, showing each recorded action, actor, entity, and metadata with retry handling on load error.

nodes.name: ForgotPasswordPage.tsx

nodes.name: GoogleSignInButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Loads the Google Identity Services script and renders a Google sign-in button that delivers a credential token to a callback.

nodes.name: LoginPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Login page supporting email/password and Google sign-in, applying the session tokens and redirecting authenticated users into the app.

nodes.name: ResetPasswordPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page for setting a new password using a reset token from the URL, with password confirmation validation.

nodes.name: SignupPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Account creation page collecting name, email, and password, applying the new session and redirecting to onboarding.

nodes.name: CampaignsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Manages trust payment-link campaigns: lists them, creates new ones, uploads/replaces payment QR codes, toggles active state, copies links, and deletes campaigns.

nodes.name: TrustDashboard.tsx
nodes.summary: Trust dashboard showing either a member's own donation summary or an admin view with total collected, today's collections, recent transactions, campaigns, and recent members.

nodes.name: DonatePage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public donation landing page for a campaign or trust, showing suggested amounts, payment QR / UPI ID copy, and join-to-donate flow for logged-in non-members.

nodes.name: MemberDonatePage.tsx
nodes.summary: Donation page for trust members who lack donation:create permission: pay via UPI/QR, attach proof, and submit for admin verification.

nodes.name: CreateDonationPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin form to record an offline donation with multiple split payment methods (cash/UPI), proof uploads, UPI collection with QR, awaiting-payment mode, and receipt download/share after success.

nodes.name: DonationDetailPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Donation detail view showing amount, status, category, payment breakdown splits with per-split verify, receipts list with PDF download, and voiding for authorized roles.

nodes.name: DonationsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin dashboard page listing all Pāvati donations for the active trust with search, payment-mode, status, and category filters plus PDF receipt downloads.

nodes.name: LandingPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public landing/marketing page for Pāvati Pustak with hero, feature grid, how-it-works steps, and a decorative receipt mockup; redirects logged-in users to the dashboard.

nodes.name: CommitteePage.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the trust committee grouped by role, showing members who hold administrative positions with their profile images and positions.

nodes.name: MembersPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Member management page allowing search, add/invite, role and position updates, permission toggles, and member removal across the active trust.

nodes.name: NotificationsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Shows the notification outbox with per-channel status along with WhatsApp/email channel preference toggles for auto-sending receipt notifications.

nodes.name: CreateTrustWizard.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-step onboarding wizard for creating a new trust, collecting trust details, festivals, join mode, and contact info with logo upload, then displaying generated join and unique codes.

nodes.name: JoinTrustPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Lets a user join a trust by entering a join code, looking up the trust details and posting a join request, then refreshing the session.

nodes.name: OnboardingPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Onboarding hub listing the user's existing trusts (to switch active trust) with links to create a new trust or find and join one.

nodes.name: TrustSearchPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public trust search page allowing users to search trusts by name or city, view them, and join open or approval-mode trusts.

nodes.name: ReceiptPreviewPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Page that loads a single receipt and displays its generated PDF inline with a download button.

nodes.name: ReceiptVerifyPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Public receipt verification page that validates a receipt by a security token, showing its authenticity and an embedded PDF, or an error if invalid.

nodes.name: ReceiptsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Receipt management page listing generated Pāvati receipts with search, status filter, PDF download, and WhatsApp/email sending to donors.

nodes.name: ReportsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Donation reporting dashboard with summary stat cards, daily collection and payment-mode charts (recharts), category allocation, and collector performance bars, plus CSV export.

nodes.name: TrustSettingsPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Trust settings editor for basic details, join code display, membership join mode, contact/location info, festivals, and a guarded danger zone to permanently delete the trust.

nodes.name: TemplateEditorPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Visual receipt template editor with page-size controls, background image upload, field list management, a draggable field overlay, and a live receipt preview.

nodes.name: TemplatesPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Lists Pāvati receipt templates with visual previews, showing active/inactive status and actions to edit, activate, delete, or create new templates.

nodes.name: TrustPublicProfile.tsx
nodes.summary: Public trust profile page showing trust details, member/stat cards, committee, recent donors, and join/donate actions based on auth state.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Central HTTP client for the web app: token management, fetch wrapper with automatic refresh on 401, REST helpers (get/post/patch/del), file upload, receipt PDF download, and CSV export.

nodes.name: auth-actions.ts
nodes.summary: Logout helpers that revoke the refresh token via the API, clear local tokens, reset the auth store, and optionally navigate to the login page.

nodes.name: festivals.ts
nodes.summary: Festival and donation category helpers combining default categories with a trust's custom festivals, plus a hook to fetch a trust's festival types.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand auth store holding the user, memberships, and active trust ID, with session/trust setters, logout, and a useActiveTrust selector.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: General frontend utilities: class-name merging, INR/date formatting re-exports, relative time strings, file-to-data-URL reading, and blob downloads.

nodes.name: canvas.ts
nodes.summary: Browser-side receipt renderer using the HTML Canvas 2D API. Renders draw operations (text, images, lines) onto a scaled canvas with cover-fit background support and exports canvas-to-blob conversion.

nodes.name: fonts.ts
nodes.summary: Font management layer for the receipt engine. Provides a global FONT_CACHE for PDF font measurement, CSS font-string generation from family names, and register/unregister lifecycle for pdf-lib PDFFont instances.

nodes.name: layout.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the layout engine. Covers pagePx size calculations, normalizeFont weight mapping, buildFieldValues formatting (Indian numbering, payment mode labels, Hindi footer), wrapText line-breaking, and buildDrawOps output for various field configurations.

nodes.name: layout.ts
nodes.summary: Core layout engine that transforms receipt template field configurations and data into an ordered array of DrawOp objects. Handles field value formatting (Indian number system, date, payment mode), text wrapping with measurement, signature line rendering, and percentage-to-pixel coordinate mapping with font scaling.

nodes.name: pdf.ts
nodes.summary: Node-side PDF receipt renderer using pdf-lib. Embeds Mukta font variants, converts draw operations to PDF drawing commands with px-to-pt coordinate conversion, supports embedded background/logo/QR images (JPG/PNG), and provides a heuristic Devanagari-aware text measurement function.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions, constants, and utility functions for the receipt engine. Defines the complete receipt data model (ReceiptData, ReceiptTemplateView, DrawOp), font key system with CSS weight mappings, field key/label enumerations, default A5 field layout configuration, page size pixel maps, and mm-to-px conversion.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Central constant definitions for the Pāvati Pustak trust management platform. Defines all role enumerations (PRIMARY_ADMIN through COLLECTOR), role ordering for hierarchy, payment modes (CASH, UPI, MIXED), donation categories and statuses, privacy levels, member statuses, join modes, receipt statuses, notification statuses and channels, audit action types, page size constants with millimeter dimensions, and suggested donation amounts. Also exports derived TypeScript union types for each constant group.

nodes.name: permissions.ts
nodes.summary: Role-based access control (RBAC) permission system for the trust platform. Defines 36 granular permission strings organized by resource (trust, member, donation, receipt, template, campaign, announcement, report, settings, notification, audit, donate). Maps each TrustRole to an explicit array of granted permissions, where PRIMARY_ADMIN receives ALL_PERMISSIONS and lower roles receive progressively fewer. Includes a fallback `permissionsForRole()` function, a complete PERMISSION_LABELS map for UI display, and an `everyone` baseline permission set that every authenticated user inherits.

nodes.name: schemas.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Zod validation schemas for all trust platform input forms and API endpoints. Covers authentication (login, register, forgot/reset password, Google OAuth), trust CRUD (create, update), member management (add, update), donation creation with payment splits and cross-field validation, campaign and announcement management, receipt template configuration with nested field configs, notification settings, profile updates, password changes, and reusable validators for phone (Indian 10-digit), email (strict regex with disposable-email blocking), slugs, and amounts. Exports inferred TypeScript types for each schema. Also exports a curated list of 30 disposable email domains blocked during registration.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript interface definitions for all domain entities in the trust platform. Defines 14 core interfaces: User (authentication profile), Trust (organization with settings and privacy flags), TrustMember (membership link with role and permissions), Donor, Donation (with status, payment mode, privacy, and optional splits), Receipt, ReceiptFieldConfig (template positioning metadata), ReceiptTemplate, PaymentCampaign, Announcement, NotificationLog, AuditLogEntry, and composite types TrustMemberWithUser, TrustWithStats, and AuthSession. Each interface mirrors the Prisma database schema structure with string-typed IDs and ISO date strings for API transport.

nodes.name: router.tsx
nodes.summary: Central SPA router using react-router-dom createBrowserRouter. Defines all application routes with three layered auth guards: RequireAuth (login check), RequireMembership (trust membership check), and RequirePermission (role-based RBAC via permissionsForRole). All page components are code-split via React.lazy. Includes AppShell root layout with Suspense fallback and Sonner toast notifications.

nodes.name: i18n.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight i18n system supporting three locales: English, Marathi (mr), and Hindi (hi). Provides dictionary-based translation with localStorage persistence, English fallback, and a setLocale/getLocale/t() API. Includes localeOptions array for UI dropdowns. Covers navigation labels, common actions, and currency (₹) formatting.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: React application bootstrap that initializes QueryClient, restores locale from localStorage, fetches the current user session via /auth/me API endpoint, and renders the app tree (StrictMode > QueryClientProvider > RouterProvider) into the DOM root. Uses a one-shot render guard to prevent double rendering during async session restore.

nodes.name: file::Procfile
nodes.summary: Heroku process definition file specifying two process types: a release phase that runs Prisma migrations against the API schema, and a web process that boots the compiled Node.js API server.

nodes.name: file::opencode-session.json

nodes.name: file::package.json
nodes.summary: Root monorepo manifest for pavati-pustak. Defines npm workspaces (packages/*, apps/*), orchestrates build/test/typecheck across all workspaces, configures Heroku postbuild (Prisma generate + build), and declares shared devDependencies (concurrently, TypeScript 5.6).

nodes.name: file::tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Shared base TypeScript configuration inherited by all workspace packages. Targets ES2022 with ESNext modules and Bundler resolution, enables strict mode with additional checks (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch), and supports both Node and DOM lib environments.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Single-page application HTML shell for Pāvati Pustak. Provides the root div mount point, loads the React entry module (src/main.tsx), and declares PWA manifest, favicon, theme-color, and meta description.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm package definition for the @pavati/web app. Defines Vite-based dev/build/preview/typecheck scripts and declares React 19, react-router-dom, TanStack Query, Zustand, Recharts, react-hook-form + Zod, Tailwind CSS v4, and internal workspace packages as dependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the web app. Targets ES2022, enables strict mode with additional checks (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch), uses react-jsx transform, Bundler module resolution, and includes only the src/ directory.

nodes.name: heroku-r2-deployment.md
nodes.summary: Heroku + Cloudflare R2 deployment plan covering 7 phases: R2 storage driver implementation, deploy artifacts, local verification, Cloudflare R2 setup, Heroku provisioning, DNS configuration for pavati.tech, and Google OAuth go-live. Includes architecture diagram, smoke test checklist, rollback strategy, and cost breakdown.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Exclusion configuration for the understand analysis tool. Lists gitignore-mirrored patterns (.env files, uploads, dev.db), test file patterns for JS/TS/C#/Java/Go/C++/Python/Rust/Ruby/Swift, all currently commented out as suggestions.

nodes.name: config.json

nodes.name: scan-result.json
nodes.summary: Full project scan result for Pavati Pustak monorepo. Contains 132 files across 8 languages, 16 detected frameworks, workspace structure for 4 packages (@pavati/api, @pavati/web, @pavati/receipt-engine, @pavati/shared), and the complete import map with 316 edges. Estimated complexity: moderate.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: API server package manifest for @pavati/api v0.1.0. ESM module with Express server, Prisma ORM, AWS S3/R2 storage, Google OAuth, pdf-lib receipt generation, Zod validation, and pino logging. 20 dependencies, 12 dev dependencies. Scripts for dev/build/test/database management.

nodes.name: init/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Initial database migration creating the complete PostgreSQL schema. Defines 12 enums (AuthProvider, TrustRole, MemberStatus, JoinMode, PaymentMode, DonationStatus, DonationPrivacy, ReceiptStatus, PageSize, NotificationChannel, NotificationStatus, AnnouncementType) and 16 tables (User, OtpCode, RefreshToken, Trust, TrustMember, Donor, Donation, Receipt, ReceiptTemplate, ReceiptNumberConfig, PaymentCampaign, PaymentTransaction, Announcement, AnnouncementRead, Notification, AuditLog, TrustInvite, JoinRequest) with all foreign keys, indexes, and unique constraints.

nodes.name: receipt_number_unique_per_trust/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration changing receipt number uniqueness from global to per-trust. Drops the global Receipt_receiptNumber_key unique index and creates a composite unique index on (trustId, receiptNumber), allowing different trusts to use overlapping receipt numbers.

nodes.name: drop_otp_codes/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration removing the OtpCode table. The phone-based OTP authentication flow was replaced by email/Google auth, making the OTP table obsolete.

nodes.name: add_trust_qr_code_url/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding a nullable qrCodeUrl text column to the Trust table for QR code generation.

nodes.name: move_qr_to_campaign/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration moving QR code URL from Trust to PaymentCampaign table. Adds qrCodeUrl to PaymentCampaign and drops it from Trust, reflecting that QR codes are per-campaign rather than per-trust.

nodes.name: add_donation_splits/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding the DonationSplit model for mixed payment mode support. Extends PaymentMode enum with MIXED value, creates DonationSplit table with foreign keys to Donation and TrustMember (verifiedBy), adds index on donationId, and backfills one split per existing donation with verified status.

nodes.name: add_donation_submitted_by/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding submittedById foreign key to Donation table, linking to TrustMember. Tracks who submitted a donation record (distinct from collector who physically received it).

nodes.name: migration_lock.toml
nodes.summary: Prisma migration lock file pinning the database provider to PostgreSQL. Prevents accidentally applying migrations to a different database engine.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Complete Prisma schema defining the Pavati Pustak data model. 12 enums and 18 models covering User management (User, RefreshToken), Trust organization (Trust, TrustMember, TrustInvite, JoinRequest), financial tracking (Donation, DonationSplit, Donor, PaymentCampaign, PaymentTransaction), receipt generation (Receipt, ReceiptTemplate, ReceiptNumberConfig), communication (Announcement, AnnouncementRead, Notification), and audit (AuditLog). PostgreSQL datasource with UUID primary keys, composite unique constraints, and cascade delete relationships.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Database seed script that clears all existing data and creates a production admin user (Pranay Pawar) with email auth and bcrypt-hashed password. Used for initial setup and development resets.

nodes.name: google.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite for Google OAuth authentication endpoint. Tests rejection of invalid id tokens (401) and malformed request bodies (422) when mock mode is disabled. Sets up Express app and Prisma client in beforeAll/afterAll hooks.

nodes.name: permissions.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite validating the RBAC permission system from @pavati/shared. Verifies PRIMARY_ADMIN gets all permissions, COLLECTOR has limited access (create donation/receipt only), committee roles can view all donations, MEMBER/VOLUNTEER can only view own, ADMIN can manage templates, and unknown roles fall back to everyone set.

nodes.name: schemas.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Vitest test suite for Zod validation schemas from @pavati/shared. Tests registerSchema (email normalization, disposable domain rejection, password strength), joinByCodeSchema, selfDonationSchema (amount bounds, proof URL validation), createDonationSchema (required fields, splits sum validation, awaitingPayment logic), createTemplateSchema (field configs, coordinate bounds), createTrustSchema & updateTrustSchema (custom festivals, empty list rejection, trimming), and custom categories across donation/campaign schemas.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the API server. Extends root tsconfig.base.json with ESNext module, Bundler resolution, Node types, no declaration output. Compiles src and prisma directories to dist/.

nodes.name: manifest.webmanifest
nodes.summary: PWA web app manifest for Pavati Pustak. Configures standalone display mode, saffron theme color (#f97316), cream background (#fff7ed), and a 192x192 PNG icon. Enables add-to-homescreen installation.

nodes.name: index.css

Defines custom theme with Indian-inspired color palette (saffron, maroon, gold, cream), custom fonts (Mukta, Noto Sans Devanagari), CSS animations (fade-in, slide-up, float), reusable component classes (card, btn variants, input, label, badge), and custom scrollbar styling. Uses @theme directive for CSS-first configuration.

nodes.name: tsconfig.tsbuildinfo

nodes.name: copy-fonts.mjs
nodes.summary: Build script that copies 4 Mukta font files (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold) from src/fonts/ to dist/fonts/. Uses Node.js fs/path modules, creates output directory if missing, and exits with error if any source font is absent.

nodes.summary: Public barrel entry point for the receipt-engine package. Re-exports all client-facing types, layout, canvas rendering, and font utilities.

nodes.summary: Server-side barrel exporting PDF rendering functions, font file accessors, and Node-specific receipt types from the receipt-engine package.

nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the receipt-engine package. Extends root base config, targets ESNext modules with Bundler resolution, outputs to dist/.

nodes.summary: npm package manifest for @pavati/shared. Defines the package entry point, build/typecheck scripts, and declares zod as its sole runtime dependency.

nodes.summary: Public barrel entry point for the @pavati/shared package. Re-exports all constants, permissions, types, schemas, and utilities, plus zod and ZodSchema from the zod library.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Collection of shared utility functions for Indian currency formatting (INR), date localization, amount-to-words conversion, initials extraction, random code generation, and text slugification.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the @pavati/shared package. Extends root base config, targets ESNext modules with Bundler resolution, outputs to dist/.

layers.name: API Server
layers.description: Express REST API implementation: entry point, config, shared lib utilities (email, HTTP, JWT, session, logger, Prisma), request middleware (auth, error, rate limit, RBAC, validation), 13 route modules (auth, trusts, members, donations, templates, receipts, campaigns, announcements, notifications, reports, users, uploads, dashboard), external providers (messaging, storage), and business services (audit, notifications, receipts PDF).

layers.name: API Data Layer
layers.description: Persistence layer for the API: Prisma schema (domain model with 12 enums and 18 models), PostgreSQL migration history, migration lock, and the seed script that creates the production admin user.

layers.name: API Configuration
layers.description: Build and package configuration for the API workspace: npm package manifest (dependencies, scripts) and TypeScript compiler configuration extending the root base.

layers.name: Web UI (React Application)
layers.description: React 19 application screens: 17 feature directories (auth, donations, receipts, templates, members, campaigns, reports, dashboard, announcements, notifications, onboarding, settings, audit, donate, landing, account, trust) plus 7 shared components (ui kit, layout, logo, festival picker, receipt preview, template field overlay, logout button).

layers.name: Web Core (Application Shell)
layers.description: Web application bootstrap and infrastructure shell: React entry point (main.tsx), central router with auth/membership/permission guards, i18n system, shared lib layer (HTTP API client, auth actions, festival helpers, Zustand stores, utils), the SPA HTML shell, global Tailwind styles, and PWA manifest.

layers.name: Web Configuration
layers.description: Build and package configuration for the web workspace: npm package manifest, TypeScript compiler configuration, Vite build/dev-server config with API proxy, and incremental build info cache.

layers.name: Shared Package
layers.description: @pavati/shared workspace package consumed by both API and web: domain type definitions, Zod validation schemas, RBAC permissions map, constants/enums, shared utilities (INR/date formatting), the public barrel, and its package/tsconfig config.

layers.name: Receipt Engine
layers.description: @pavati/receipt-engine workspace package producing donation receipt PDFs: layout engine (DrawOp generation), Node-side pdf-lib PDF renderer (Devanagari-aware, embedded images), browser-side Canvas renderer, font management, type definitions, client and server barrels, build script, and package/tsconfig config.

layers.name: Root & Tooling Configuration
layers.description: Monorepo root and tooling files: root npm workspaces manifest, shared tsconfig.base.json, Heroku Procfile, deployment plan documentation, and analysis-tool configuration and outputs.

layers.name: Tests
layers.description: Test suites across the monorepo: API integration and unit tests (app smoke test, Google OAuth, WhatsApp notifications, permission/RBAC, Zod schema validation) and receipt-engine layout unit tests, all run with Vitest.
